ov: Four species of large, pale antelopes with dark markings on the face and legs and long, nearly straight horns. They live in near-desert conditions, can go long periods without water, and gather in herds of up to 600.

why.et: A common game-ranch animal, hunted for meat, hide and horns.

rg: Dry lands of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula; gemsbok were also released in New Mexico, USA.
df: Grasses and forbs, plus melons and cucumbers that supply water.
fx: The Arabian oryx died out in the wild in 1972; in 2011 it became the first species moved back from "extinct in the wild" to vulnerable.
Its horns can be deadly: oryxes have been known to kill lions with them.
